run_xacro_cli: run xacro_standalone.py with -o flag to expand a .xacro file into pretty-printed XML output
run_xacro_deps: run xacro_standalone.py with --deps flag to print all included file dependencies for a xacro file
run_xacro_includes_only: run xacro_standalone.py with --includes flag to evaluate only include tags without macro expansion
eval_text_expressions: use eval_text to evaluate xacro expressions like dollar-brace math and property substitutions in a string
process_includes_xml: use process_includes to resolve xacro include tags and glob patterns in an XML DOM document
